note: RV park on the north shore of Eagle Lake, across Stones Road from the lake: an easy walk or a short drive to the water depending on the lake level. Direct access to BLM land with hiking, biking and ATV trails. --Claude
summary: American Eagle RV Park: operator site + Esri + Google. $40 50A FHU / $20 non-hookup confirmed (passes the $50 gate), 55 sites, May 1-Nov 1 (home page says year-round), email/phone booking only, showers/laundry/wifi. Google 4.7 (47), RV Life 5.0/$$. Not waterfront confirmed.
flags: PRIVATE GATES: price $40 a night for a 50-amp full-hookup site (rates page, read 2026-11-26) - under US$50, no gateway needed. Presence: working website with phone (530) 250-7541. Google 4.7 (47); RV Life 5.0/$$ stored.

LONG-STAY: weekly ($240), monthly ($850 + electric) and full-season ($2,500, plus $350 winter storage) rates are posted beside the nightly rate. Test 2 passes (posted nightly rate); test 3 passes (nightly sold); test 5 passes (no lots or homes sold; one park model rented by the night). Test 4 (nightly share) unmeasured: no booking engine, booking is by email. The site leads with 'Starting @ $40/night' and markets transient stays; read as an ordinary park, not mostly seasonal.

OHV (flag only): the park markets 'Direct access from our park to BLM land with 70 miles of hiking, biking, and ATV trails'. It is a general RV park with trail access (hiking/biking/ATV named together), not an OHV staging camp; reviewer decides.

Season conflict on the operator's own pages: rates page 'Open seasonally from May 1st to Nov 1st. (depending on weather)' vs home page 'Open Year Round!'. Wrote the rates page's dates and both in season.note.
Pin 40.7189,-120.7236 (Google's) sits on Stones Rd ~120 m east of the RV loops; better 40.7188,-120.7252 (under 250 m, optional).
WATERFRONT not waterfront confirmed: loops ~400 m from the marshy shore past Stones Rd, buildings and a paved lot; operator says 'directly across the street from Eagle Lake'.

Fees: the stored fees group is manual (2026-11-07) and matches the 2026-11-26 read ($20-$40), so it was not rewritten. For a reviewer, the rates page also gives: 'Weekly $240, monthly $850 plus electricity, full season $2,500'.
